decisions.statement: A key the page's page type does not declare secret is refused.
The refusal names the keys that page type declares.
A key that was the last one the sops file had takes the file with that key.
A key the sops file does not have is refused rather than passed over.
The rest of the file is enciphered again and landed as one change.
Nothing here reads a secret out of an earlier commit.
Nothing here puts back the secret this command dropped.

definition: the command dropping one secret from the sops file beside a page
